This repo gitignores 'mcp.json', so copy this to a real mcp.json location yourself: '~/.cursor/mcp.json' (all projects) or '.cursor/mcp.json' (this project only, stays untracked). For Cursor CLOUD agents, .cursor/mcp.json is NOT read — register the same command/args in the Cursor dashboard under Integrations & MCP instead. See scripts/setup/README.md.
